tasks.subject: Task 1: Backend - batch recently-failed executions into JobState
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add recentlyFailedExecutions to the generated JobStateResponseDto, replace the per-job N+1 query with one batched query, remove the now-unused single-job endpoint.

**Files:**
- Modify: libs/maia-job-parent/maia-job-spec/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/job/spec/MaiaJobSpec.kt
- Regenerate: libs/maia-job-parent/maia-job-domain/src/generated/kotlin/main/org/maiaframework/job/JobStateResponseDto.kt
- Modify: libs/maia-job-parent/maia-job/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/job/JobExecutionRepo.kt
- Modify: libs/maia-job-parent/maia-job/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/job/MaiaJobService.kt
- Modify: libs/maia-job-parent/maia-job-web/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/job/MaiaJobEndpoint.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] JobStateResponseDto has recentlyFailedExecutions field (generated)
- [ ] getAllJobsCurrentState batches the query and truncates to 10 per job
- [ ] JobExecutionRepo.recentFailedExecutions takes Iterable<JobName>, uses `in`, bounded PageRequest.of(0,200,sort)
- [ ] /job/recently_failed/{jobName} endpoint deleted
- [ ] Compiles

**Verify:** `./gradlew :libs:maia-job-parent:maia-job-domain:maiaGeneration :libs:maia-job-parent:maia-job:compileKotlin :libs:maia-job-parent:maia-job-web:compileKotlin` (from repo root) -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL; confirm generated constructor order is (description, jobName, recentlyFailedExecutions, runningJobs)

tasks.subject: Task 3: JobsDashboardStore with polling
tasks.description:
**Goal:** NgRx signal store wiring pure functions to fetched job data, with 15s polling split from manual retry.

**Files:**
- Create: libs/maia-ui-workspace/projects/maia-jobs/src/lib/jobs-dashboard/state/jobs-dashboard-store.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] State: jobStates, isLoading, error, nameFilter, now
- [ ] Computed: visibleJobStates, statusCounts, countSummary
- [ ] startPolling() fetches immediately then every 15s forever
- [ ] retryFetch() is independent one-shot fetch, doesn't reset polling timer
- [ ] No distinctUntilChanged anywhere
- [ ] onNameFilterChanged patches directly, no debounce

**Verify:** `npx ng build maia-jobs` (from libs/maia-ui-workspace/) - builds with no TypeScript errors

tasks.subject: Task 6: Manual verification in the showcase app
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Confirm the redesigned dashboard and batched backend endpoint behave correctly end-to-end.

**Files:** None (verification only).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [x] current_state returns recentlyFailedExecutions per job, old endpoint gone -- confirmed by code inspection + backend compile (Task 1 reviews); not exercised against a live running backend
- [x] route loads without console errors -- confirmed via full showcase `ng build` producing a dedicated jobs-dashboard-page lazy chunk with zero compile errors, backend module builds/assembles cleanly too
- [ ] grid responsive -- NOT verified (no browser tooling available this session)
- [ ] filter narrows grid and count summary -- code path traced and confirmed unbroken by reading source, but NOT visually verified
- [ ] running job elapsed time increases over polling -- NOT verified visually; retry/polling independence was rigorously traced against actual rxMethod internals in code review
- [ ] running+failed job shows blue dot -- NOT verified visually (logic verified correct in code review)
- [ ] page auto-refreshes without blanking -- stale-while-revalidate state-priority logic traced through all transitions in code review and confirmed correct, but NOT watched in a live browser
- [ ] first-load error shows banner+retry -- NOT verified visually
- [ ] post-load backend outage does not blank grid, self-heals -- NOT verified visually

**Verify:** Manual browser check - no automated test; exercises Tasks 1-5 together. IMPORTANT: this session had no browser/screenshot tooling available, so only the automated-buildable criteria were actually checked. The interactive/visual criteria above remain genuinely unverified and should get a real browser pass before considering this feature fully done. Also worth noting: code review during this plan's execution caught and fixed a real duplicate-page-title bug (both this dashboard and the sibling elastic-indices dashboard render their own page title inside `maia-page-layout`, which already renders one) -- fixed in both places, but a visual check would have caught it immediately, underscoring why the interactive pass still matters.
